      description: If the Planner repeatedly sends the same or insufficiently refined queries without incorporating new insights from previous WebSurfer outputs, the conversation may enter an unproductive loop.
      severity: 0.60

      likely_effect_on_to_agent: WebSurfer will waste resources searching for the same information, and the Planner will not progress toward a definitive answer.

  agent_failure_modes:

  agent_failure_modes:

      severity: 0.65
